name: @jobportal/domain
description: Shared domain logic — URL slugs, job visibility, and the SRP/directory/article param parsers. Imported by apps/web (SSR) and apps/api (REST) so the two cannot drift.
//exports: Explicit subpath map, matching @jobportal/ui and @jobportal/observability. Named rather than a './*' wildcard so the public surface is documented and internals cannot be reached. tsconfig paths alone are not enough — vitest and Node resolve through this map, and without it a subpath import typechecks but fails at runtime.
